description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist, Veyran and Birgi trigger twice each.
Resolve both Birgi triggers, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve both Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
